original_card.question: Can a legal decoder or coframe change improve the full signed moment, including changed helper targets?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A source-bound arbitrary-input identity and legal producer/consumer boundary with the complete paid and productive target invoice, including restoration, ownership, native alignment and extra charges. Price under the actual current model; historical ceiling.py assumptions must be established before use. A favorable optimistic relaxation keeps a route open but is not a completed supplier. A scoped local result remains useful; expansion requires the family-level budget gate.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: Price one complete changed itinerary with both paid and productive histograms. Check #5693/#5698 for overlap and their exact hypotheses before another coframe search. Use the signed invoice preflight where its boundary contract agrees; an inconclusive concave comparison is not a power crossing. Stop if an optimistic complete budget fails at the chosen target or native delivery remains unspecified.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.

Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

existing_checks.scope: Selected PR5599: complete helper-subspace construction and independent caller replay; five framework assumptions remain.
existing_checks.remaining: The next experiment must identify uncovered source-specific work. Successor archive intake does not transfer this admission.

actual_scope: Upper bounds for the F2 shadow minranks mr2(Gamma_E6) and mr2(Gamma_E7) left open in PR #2277 (research/overcomplete-and-realisation-floors, Open next question 5): minimum F2 rank of a matrix on the 36 E6 or 63 E7 root lines with unit diagonal and zeros on every orthogonal pair.
scope_change_reason: Side result on the decoder-cost shadow lemma, not a decoder or coframe change. It answers part of a precisely stated open question in the decoder-floor lineage and needs no supplier or invoice.
bottleneck_link: Side result. PR #2277's shadow lemma bounds the cost of any exact root-code decoder by rank_L(B o N). A rank bound on N limits how far F2-valued B-independent shadows can certify decoder floors; no kappa, decoder or supplier consequence is claimed.
stop_rule: Ship the first verified improvement: explicit witnesses giving new upper bounds. Do not continue into the E6 rank-7 or E7 rank-8..10 decision within the 60-minute budget.
evidence: WITNESSES.json gives N = U V^T over F2 with U, V of widths 8 (E6) and 11 (E7). verify.py rebuilds both line sets from E8, checks all 1296 and 3969 pattern entries, computes exact F2 ranks 8 and 11, and rejects a diagonal and an orthogonal-entry mutation. With the cited PR #2277 lower bounds: mr2(Gamma_E6) in {7,8}, 8 <= mr2(Gamma_E7) <= 11.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Is mr2(Gamma_E6) equal to 7 or 8?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the last undecided value for E6; rank 7 would match the global fitting minrank of SAT-1.
open_questions.first_step: Run the rank-7 instance with symmetry breaking under W(E6), possibly via an elliptic-quadric model of the 36 lines (not checked here), and keep a DRAT proof if UNSAT.
open_questions.blocked_by: A plain CaDiCaL run fixing U on one maximum orthogonal 4-set was stopped unfinished after 12 minutes.

open_questions.question: What is mr2(Gamma_E7) in {8,9,10,11}?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It fixes the exact F2 shadow capacity on E7; the lower bound is one above T = 7.
open_questions.first_step: Decide rank 10 first. The 63 lines carry the Sp(6,2) structure, which gives strong symmetry breaking.
open_questions.blocked_by: Plain CaDiCaL runs did not finish: rank 8 stopped after 12 minutes, rank 9 at a 600 s limit, rank 10 at a 150 s limit. No partition of the 63 lines into nine pairwise non-orthogonal 7-sets exists (verify.py), so the clique-cover route to rank 9 is closed.

open_questions.question: Do larger fields of characteristic 2 lower either value?
open_questions.why_it_matters: PR #2277 section 8.5 leaves characteristic-2 extension fields open; the witnesses here are F2 matrices and transfer upward unchanged.
open_questions.first_step: Encode GF(4) entries and repeat the rank-7 E6 test.
